title: Matt Smith Reacts to Keanu Reeves Watching Morbius on a Flight
text:
During a podcast, Matt Smith expressed shock and humor upon discovering Keanu Reeves watched the much-maligned film Morbius on a plane, while also praising Reeves as an iconic actor.
Actor Matt Smith , known for his role in The House of the Dragon, delivered a humorous and self-deprecating reaction upon learning that Keanu Reeves had watched the critically panned film Morbius during a flight.
The comment came during an appearance on Brittany Broski's Royal Court podcast. Smith expressed disbelief that Reeves, a global movie star, would choose the 2022 Sony-Marvel release from an in-flight entertainment catalog. His immediate exclamation was "f- off.
" When asked what he would watch on a journey, Smith firmly replied, "Not f-ing Morbius," and speculated that Reeves must have been under the influence or simply "having a moment" to select that title. Despite his mockery of the film, Smith emphasized his profound admiration for Reeves, calling him an "angel" and the ideal guardian angel.
He praised Reeves's era of 1990s films, from Point Break onward, stating, "I genuinely think that that period of movies, that sort of '90s period of films I just love... I just think he's the best.
" The irony is notable, as Smith played Milo in Morbius, a film that performed poorly both critically and commercially. The discussion also touched on broader industry updates, including Netflix adding the acclaimed 2014 thriller "Gone Girl," Helen Slater defending the Supergirl casting, the development of Paranormal Activity 8, DreamWorks' new "Forgotten Island," Netflix's series cancellations in 2026, a countdown trailer for Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey," a director's sentencing linked to stolen funds, HBO Max's dual Marvel sequel versions, the success of House of the Dragon, and Reeves joining a new LEGO film
